composition.name: SoftstageStoreTrailerR2
workflow: Select three source images in Explorer.
Right-click and open the Softstage command.
Hover over and click the real Create composition with Softstage command.
Zoom into the real PNG tile, then return to the folder view.
Double-click the PNG and cut to one full-window Photos view.
composition.capturePolicy: The edit uses multiple real recordings. It does not present them as one uncut take. No cursor, menu, output, or Windows control is recreated.

timeline.scene: Real command hover and click, enlarged 2.2x
One PNG appears; smooth centered zoom on the real thumbnail
Real double-click, then hard cut before the dark loading pause
Full Photos view of the same composition

deliverables.purpose: Shareable 1080p preview with quiet sound effects
50 Mbps Store master with quiet sound effects
Silent video copy of the Store master
Low-resolution review copy with sound effects

verification.containerProbe: ffprobe confirmed dimensions, frame rate, frame count, duration, streams, and bit rates for all four files.
verification.typeCheck: Ran npx tsc --noEmit from video/ after the final composition edit; it passed.
visualReview: Review frame 444 at 14.8 seconds shows the real command hover and click in the readable close-up.
Review frame 597 at 19.9 seconds shows the centered zoom peak with the full PNG tile in view.
Review frame 747 at 24.9 seconds shows three source images and one generated PNG tile.
Frame 752 is the last Explorer frame and shows one output tile. Frame 753 cuts to the full Photos view. There is no overlap, extra output, or black loading gap.
verification.sourceReview: The edit uses real screen recordings for selection, right-click, menu navigation, command hover and click, PNG output, and double-click. The Photos view is a separate real recording.
